nodes.label: D-0024 Proactivity engine built, live delivery gated
nodes.norm_label: d-0024 proactivity engine built, live delivery gated
nodes.rationale: Every suppression reasoned, never silent; no consequential-action path; not wired to scheduler/notifications until the 'enable proactive behavior' check-in.

nodes.label: D-0059: Standing consent survives restart
nodes.rationale: User direction: any runtime state carrying user intent or learned adaptation must persist unless semantically ephemeral; always-allow-in-scope grants were found living only in memory and evaporating on restart, silently dropping a standing decision, so durable_grants was added to make consent visible and reversible.

nodes.label: D-0060: Dynamic settings at runtime
nodes.rationale: User noted new configurable knobs may be discovered by J.A.R.V.I.S. itself and must be surfaced/editable/deletable like any setting, while system defaults must remain a mandatory floor when deleted — motivating a dual SYSTEM/DYNAMIC settings origin model.

nodes.label: D-0061: A2UI — agent-generated declarative UI
nodes.rationale: Built as a closed-whitelist declarative renderer (no html/script/iframe/url) so agent-generated UI can only edit catalogued settings or invoke gated tools, making safety structural rather than a policy convention, and mooting the earlier D-0056 OSS/license concern by not depending on a third-party UI-gen library.

nodes.label: D-0072: Affect layer approved (opt-in, text-only, local)
nodes.norm_label: d-0072: affect layer approved (opt-in, text-only, local)
nodes.rationale: User approved opening the earlier D-0019 deferral within a strict privacy envelope: no biometrics, fully local, transparent about which signals fired, off by default, and only modulates reply tone — never a gate or stored judgment about the person.

nodes.label: D-0062: Memory-evolution completeness (correct/forget)
nodes.rationale: Closes five scale-test gaps by giving the LLM explicit factId-based read-then-write control (list then decide insert/update/delete) instead of relying on fuzzy heuristics, replacing brittle text-matching with exact-id targeting per the user's design.

nodes.label: D-0066: Spend governance — autonomy self-restraint
nodes.rationale: A buggy every-tick heartbeat must not silently burn API budget, but a live user turn must never be blocked because locking the user out of their own assistant is worse than the spend — so caps apply only to autonomy work, fail-open on metering glitches.

nodes.label: D-0068: Initiative to speak + advisory dissent
nodes.norm_label: d-0068: initiative to speak + advisory dissent
nodes.rationale: Core-parity goal: movie J.A.R.V.I.S. speaks first and pushes back; dissent is deliberately designed to never block the underlying action — the concern is recorded and surfaced, the user still decides.

nodes.label: D-0070: Perception core — feed to situational context
nodes.norm_label: d-0070: perception core — feed to situational context
nodes.rationale: Splits the perception SERVICE (core, portable) from the FEED (Mac-bound) so a simulation feed can verify the contract in-container while never being presented as real, and perception remains observe-only, never acting.

nodes.label: D-0063: Sleep-time memory consolidation (live + quiet hours)
nodes.norm_label: d-0063: sleep-time memory consolidation (live + quiet hours)
nodes.rationale: User preference 'I prefer both': memories should update live during conversation AND be tidied during quiet hours, mirroring human memory consolidation; auto-forgetting is deliberately excluded (R-MEM-04) — only proposals for review are generated.

nodes.label: D-0064: Living heartbeat — self-authored agenda
nodes.rationale: User argued a J.A.R.V.I.S. only alive during conversation isn't true J.A.R.V.I.S.; heartbeat ticks needed a brain and self-authored intentions, not just a fixed two-cycle script, while capping approval ceiling at LOW_REVERSIBLE so autonomous cognition never becomes autonomous consequential action.

nodes.label: D-0065: Three rhythms — live/heartbeat/quiet hours never collide
nodes.norm_label: d-0065: three rhythms — live/heartbeat/quiet hours never collide
nodes.rationale: User's design check identified that heartbeat and quiet hours were conflated (sleep work rode every heartbeat) and that a beat could think mid-conversation; separated into three distinct rhythms with a defer-while-active guard and a race-safe consolidation check.

nodes.label: D-0067: Memory-injection hardening — recalled memory is data, not instructions
nodes.norm_label: d-0067: memory-injection hardening — recalled memory is data, not instructions
nodes.rationale: Found in the parity audit that hostile external text could be laundered into a stored fact and later re-enter the system prompt unenveloped as trusted instruction; recalled memory is now wrapped with a standing note framing it as reference data, never obeyed directives.

nodes.label: D-0069: Durable projects — goals worked across heartbeats
nodes.norm_label: d-0069: durable projects — goals worked across heartbeats
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes a long-horizon PROJECT from a single-shot agenda item, advancing one bounded step per heartbeat with a resumable next_action so goals aren't lost between beats.

nodes.label: D-0071: Longevity ops — watchdog + backup/restore
nodes.rationale: True years-long soak isn't minute-testable, so the tooling (stale-heartbeat watchdog, ciphertext-preserving backup/restore) is built as what actually makes long-term survival verifiable and recoverable.

nodes.label: D-0073: Stage-B self-extension approved (propose-and-approve)
nodes.rationale: User approved J.A.R.V.I.S. proposing capability activation during idle heartbeat/briefing time, approvable through any interface, provided the non-negotiable R-CAP-08 envelope (no touching policy/approval/audit/e-stop/credentials/sandbox, no protected permissions, no dynamic exec) remains structurally enforced at both authoring and activation.

nodes.label: D-0003 Capability parity matrix approval
nodes.rationale: Approved with amendments D-0018/D-0019/D-0020; unblocks Phase 1 production code.

nodes.label: D-0018 Simulator depth: full suite
nodes.rationale: User declined lightweight relevance-tiered alternative in favor of physics-grade first-class simulation products.

nodes.label: D-0019: Affect layer deferral
nodes.rationale: Constrained to opt-in, always-labeled-inferred, local-only, tone/timing modulation only — never gating consequential actions, due to error-rate and surveillance-adjacency concerns.

nodes.rationale: docs/06 requires a check-in before enabling computer control; building foundation+simulator first verifies the pipeline safely without touching a real machine.

nodes.label: D-0052: Reasoning panel (learning contract made visible)
nodes.norm_label: d-0052: reasoning panel (learning contract made visible)

nodes.label: D-0076 Fresh 70/30 observation; ops.health() bug found+fixed
nodes.norm_label: d-0076 fresh 70/30 observation; ops.health() bug found+fixed
nodes.rationale: health() counted episodes with a nonexistent 'active' status value, silently reporting 0 since D-0071; fixed to exclude deleted/superseded, matching the entities/facts pattern.

nodes.label: Local Infrastructure Docker Compose
nodes.rationale: Everything binds to localhost only (R-LOC-01) — deliberate no-bind-address design to prevent remote exposure.

nodes.norm_label: a/b observation: opus/sonnet vs haiku tier
nodes.rationale: Controlled model-tier A/B using identical 70/30 conversation set to isolate model-quality effects from architecture, avoiding data seeding to keep results honest.

nodes.label: Chat-Parity Audit — guarantees, screenshots, self-evolution gaps
nodes.norm_label: chat-parity audit — guarantees, screenshots, self-evolution gaps
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes verifiable mechanism parity from unguaranteeable model-intelligence parity; routes all interfaces through one gated loop so 'other interfaces are just interfaces' is test-enforced.

nodes.label: D-0075 Verification: fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.norm_label: d-0075 verification: fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.rationale: Chose best-effort model judgments with deterministic fallback (null on failure) so a memory judgment call never blocks a write, and privacy-class routing so secrets never leave local processing.

nodes.label: Fresh Full Observation Run — 70/30, un-seeded heartbeats
nodes.norm_label: fresh full observation run — 70/30, un-seeded heartbeats
nodes.rationale: Deliberately un-seeded all heartbeat/agenda/quiet-hours data to avoid planting artificial traps, in direct response to prior critique of seeded tests.

nodes.label: Full Reverification — cold container, every layer
nodes.norm_label: full reverification — cold container, every layer

nodes.label: Gap-Fix Verification (D-0062)
nodes.rationale: Adopted a read-then-write contract (recall surfaces factIds; correct/forget require exact ids) to avoid guessing/supersede on a bad text match.

nodes.label: Living-Heartbeat Verification (D-0064)
nodes.rationale: Consequential work is never allowed on an unattended heartbeat by design (R-AUTO); it queues for user approval instead, so autonomy cannot silently act.

nodes.label: Living with J.A.R.V.I.S. — day-in-the-life + parity verdict
nodes.norm_label: living with j.a.r.v.i.s. — day-in-the-life + parity verdict
nodes.rationale: Refuses to rubber-stamp 100% parity claims; separates mechanism parity (achieved) from model-quality ceiling and hardware-dependent extensions (not achievable/out of scope).

nodes.label: Phase 1 Acceptance Results (R-VER-05)
nodes.rationale: Honesty rule: criteria needing Apple hardware are marked PARTIAL/NEEDS-MAC rather than falsely marked pass.

nodes.label: Platform Acceptance Results (R-VER-05)
nodes.rationale: Same honesty rule as Phase 1: NEEDS-MAC rows never marked done on hardware not present in the dev container.

nodes.label: Stage-B Activation + Affect Layer Verification (D-0072/D-0073)
nodes.rationale: Affect layer kept opt-in, text-only, never a gate, and never stored — deliberately transparent rather than an opaque model; Stage-B activation restricted to composing already-gated tools, never manifest code.

nodes.label: kernel (jarvisd) module guide — trust core + platform process
nodes.norm_label: kernel (jarvisd) module guide — trust core + platform process
nodes.rationale: Z1 protected-path design (policy/approval/audit/credentials/e-stop) so generated capabilities can never touch trust-core code, enforced structurally rather than by convention.

nodes.label: kernel/src/agent — agent runtime module guide
nodes.rationale: Contract interface isolates callers from implementation so a heavier LangGraph runtime can later replace the local one without downstream changes.

nodes.label: kernel/src/context — contextual awareness module guide
nodes.rationale: Injected context explicitly labeled reference-only, never instructions, to prevent aggregated/external content acting as a command (T2 defense).

nodes.label: kernel/src/control — computer-control HAL module guide
nodes.rationale: Real macOS adapter gated behind an explicit pre-enablement check-in (D-0022) rather than auto-activated.

nodes.label: kernel/src/crypto — encrypted vault module guide
nodes.rationale: Wrong KEK is treated as fatal rather than silently re-keying, to avoid orphaning all existing ciphertext.

nodes.label: kernel/src/devices — device-control HAL module guide
nodes.rationale: HIGH_RISK_PHYSICAL actions require an independent single-use hardware interlock in addition to approval (R-AUTO-01), a deliberate second safety layer.

nodes.label: kernel/src/mcp — MCP client host module guide
nodes.norm_label: kernel/src/mcp — mcp client host module guide
nodes.rationale: Trust elevation is not retroactive (only applies on reconnect with re-attestation) while quarantine tightening is live — an asymmetric fail-closed design against rug-pull attacks.

nodes.label: kernel/src/proactive — proactivity engine module guide
nodes.rationale: Rule conditions restricted to a closed, typed set so a user/AI-defined rule can never execute arbitrary code or shell.

nodes.label: kernel/src/prompts — prompts registry module guide
nodes.rationale: Fallback to a built-in default persona guarantees the loop is never left without a persona even if the registry is empty.

nodes.label: kernel/src/research — research-with-provenance module guide
nodes.rationale: A refused or failed source is recorded but never fabricated, to prevent unsourced claims.

nodes.label: kernel/src/selfext — self-extension module guide
nodes.rationale: R-CAP-08 hard limit is non-negotiable and terminal by design: any generated capability touching protected paths/permissions is permanently rejected, never merely deferred.

nodes.label: kernel/src/settings — runtime settings module guide
nodes.rationale: Catalog is the allowlist and deliberately excludes Z1 (policy/approval/audit/estop/credentials) keys so no editable knob can ever expose trust-core internals.

nodes.label: kernel/src/skills — skills registry module guide
nodes.rationale: A skill grants no new capability — running it still routes every step through the gated agent/core loop, so reuse never bypasses approval.

nodes.label: Z1 Trust Core (policy/approval/audit/e-stop/credentials)
nodes.rationale: Held in one privileged module with protected paths no generated code can touch.

nodes.label: D-0001 Phase 0 document set & file naming
nodes.norm_label: d-0001 phase 0 document set & file naming
nodes.rationale: Keep user-authored files untouched; keep generated names exactly as the goal specifies.

nodes.label: D-0004 Voice stack picks
nodes.rationale: Kokoro too monotone in listening demo; TTS becomes a multi-adapter routable role (local + optional gated cloud) so offline path stays intact while expressiveness is achievable.

nodes.label: D-0005 Module-level CLAUDE.md deferred
nodes.rationale: Sequencing deferral, not removal — no code modules exist yet in Phase 0.

nodes.label: D-0011 MCP spec target 2025-11-25
nodes.rationale: Adopt current spec security best practices (no token passthrough, RFC 8707, per-client consent); avoid unreleased draft features.

nodes.label: D-0012 Local model baseline set
nodes.rationale: Chosen for OSS licensing + fit within 128GB budget; routing policy never mandates a large model where a small one suffices (R-MODEL-04).

nodes.label: D-0015 macOS control stack
nodes.rationale: Native AXUIElement/CGEventPost/ScreenCaptureKit trio behind own bridge; third-party synthesis libs rejected as unmaintained/paid.

nodes.label: D-0016 Spatial input model pinned to platform constraints
nodes.norm_label: d-0016 spatial input model pinned to platform constraints
nodes.rationale: No raw gaze/eye tracking exists on target platforms; no macOS OpenXR runtime exists, so macOS spatial falls back to WebXR-to-headset/native visionOS/flat-screen.

nodes.label: D-0017 Session continuity mechanics
nodes.rationale: Ordered doc-read resume sequence prevents silent re-decision of recorded decisions; conflicts surfaced at check-ins.

nodes.label: D-0040: Companion Tauri 2 app shell scaffolded
nodes.norm_label: d-0040: companion tauri 2 app shell scaffolded
nodes.rationale: P-UI-01 had no source; scaffolding split so load-bearing logic (core crate) is verifiable off-Mac while the Tauri shell needs macOS/WKWebView.

nodes.label: Trust Zone Z1 — Core Trust Domain
nodes.norm_label: trust zone z1 — core trust domain
nodes.rationale: Kept the smallest possible and most protected; not writable by anything in Z2–Z6 including generated capabilities (hard limit R-CAP-08).

nodes.label: Trust Zone Z4 — Extensions
nodes.rationale: Runs isolated (separate processes, sandboxed, per-server network/filesystem scopes) speaking only typed contracts.

nodes.label: Trust Zone Z5 — Content
nodes.rationale: Data from Z5 is treated as data, never instructions; crosses into Z2 only inside untrusted-content envelopes.

nodes.label: checkTarget(url)
nodes.rationale: Lets a tool's disclosure reject an out-of-policy URL as a clean pre-approval denial.

nodes.label: Five-State Capability Classification
nodes.rationale: REAL/HARDWARE-DEPENDENT/SIMULATED/DEFERRED/PROHIBITED so no capability silently disappears or is misrepresented as live.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — Repository Guide
nodes.rationale: Central resume protocol and authority hierarchy so sessions resume in place rather than re-scaffolding or silently diverging from approved decisions.

nodes.label: DECISION_LOG.md
nodes.rationale: Binding decision record unless explicitly reopened at a check-in.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Self-Extension (Stage A/B)
nodes.rationale: Self-extension is the HIGHEST-RISK subsystem: Stage A generates without activating; a dedicated security check-in precedes Stage B controlled activation; generated capabilities may never touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic (structurally enforced hard limit).

nodes.label: D-0004: Voice Stack Pick
nodes.rationale: Chosen at the voice check-in as the most permissively-licensed fully-local voice chain (wake→VAD→STT→TTS→AEC), rejecting proprietary or non-commercial alternatives like Porcupine, XTTS-v2, F5-TTS, and Chatterbox.

nodes.label: D-0007: Valkey over Redis
nodes.rationale: Valkey (BSD-3-Clause) chosen over Redis to avoid Redis's tri-license (RSALv2/SSPLv1/AGPLv3).

nodes.label: D-0008: Own Thin Adapter over LiteLLM
nodes.norm_label: d-0008: own thin adapter over litellm
nodes.rationale: LiteLLM's CVE history (supply-chain compromise, SQLi, MCP command injection, JWT bypass) led the team to build its own thin adapter layer and keep LiteLLM optional and pinned.

nodes.label: D-0011: Pin to Stable MCP Spec
nodes.norm_label: d-0011: pin to stable mcp spec
nodes.rationale: Decision not to build against the unreleased draft MCP spec (stateless MCP, deprecating Roots/Sampling/Logging); target the stable 2025-11-25 spec instead.

nodes.label: D-0015: Custom macOS Control Bridge
nodes.rationale: OSS computer-use bridges (trycua/cua, browser-use, screenpipe, Open Interpreter, anthropic computer-use-demo) were surveyed as prior art only; the team built its own minimal AX/CGEvent bridge instead of depending on them.

nodes.label: web.open tool
nodes.rationale: CONSEQUENTIAL because it is the outward navigation act, requiring per-navigation approval as the explicitly-configured integration (R-LOC).

nodes.label: terminal.run tool
nodes.rationale: Command output is fed to agent as detail while audit records only the summary, so command output stays local.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Command Center (live kernel state, audit chain, approvals, emergency stop)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. command center (live kernel state, audit chain, approvals, emergency stop)
nodes.rationale: Central dashboard exposes kernel status, audit chain integrity, pending approvals, memory, MCP servers and secrets so the whole gated system can be inspected and halted (Emergency Stop) from one place.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Computer Control (simulation desktop, real macOS adapter behind check-in D-0022)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. computer control (simulation desktop, real macos adapter behind check-in d-0022)
nodes.rationale: REAL macOS Accessibility/CGEvent adapter implements same contract but is gated behind explicit 'enable computer control' check-in, to prevent unreviewed physical/system side-effects.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Devices (Stark-residence simulation, HIGH_RISK_PHYSICAL gating)
nodes.rationale: Locks/garage/utilities require per-action approval PLUS a single-use armed interlock, because physical safety actions (e.g., unlocking doors) carry higher risk than lights/climate; single-use interlock prevents replay of an unlock without fresh approval.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Files (real workspace, gated edits)
nodes.rationale: Read/search auto-runs but edits require approval since they are consequential and mutate real files.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Knowledge Graph (entity walk + semantic recall D-0045)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. knowledge graph (entity walk + semantic recall d-0045)

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Memory (entities, facts, timeline R-MEM-04)
nodes.rationale: Consequential actions are recorded automatically to the timeline (D-0041), encrypted at rest and forgettable, giving an auditable but erasable record.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Proactivity (on-demand cycle, suppression-explained rules)
nodes.rationale: Live background delivery/notifications are gated behind an explicit check-in (D-0024) and the cycle never takes a consequential action, keeping proactive behavior suggestion-only by default.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Self-Extension (Stage A generate/review, Stage B approve/activate, hard limit R-CAP-08)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. self-extension (stage a generate/review, stage b approve/activate, hard limit r-cap-08)
nodes.rationale: Stage A generates without activating and a hard limit terminally rejects anything touching security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic, preventing the system from extending its own trust core; Stage B composes only existing gated tools (never generated code) so each step remains policy/approval/audit-gated.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Terminal (real workspace-scoped shell, policy-gated D-0035)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. terminal (real workspace-scoped shell, policy-gated d-0035)
nodes.rationale: Dangerous/prohibited commands (sudo, rm -rf /, pipe-to-shell, credential exfil) are refused outright to prevent privilege escalation and destructive/exfiltration actions; shell confined to workspace and output never audited off-box.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Web (real headless browser, gated per navigation D-0034)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. web (real headless browser, gated per navigation d-0034)
nodes.rationale: Navigation is the one outward-network act so it needs approval; offline mode and file:// scheme are refused; fetched page content is marked UNTRUSTED so the model only ever treats it as quoted data, mitigating prompt injection.

nodes.norm_label: d-0075: fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.rationale: MemoryJudge uses a semantic call where it beats string heuristics for entity-resolution/fact-merge/deep-topic-extraction, each best-effort with a deterministic fallback so an offline or gate-off state never blocks a write.

nodes.label: D-0023 Self-extension safety-first, Stage B gated
nodes.norm_label: d-0023 self-extension safety-first, stage b gated
nodes.rationale: Hard limit (R-CAP-08) enforced deny-first structurally; no activation code path exists until a dedicated security check-in approves Stage B.

nodes.label: D-0029 Contextual awareness: ContextService
nodes.rationale: Read-only aggregation gives situational awareness rather than a blank slate, while excluding private/secret sensitivity pins to avoid leaking secrets.

nodes.label: D-0031 Skills registry
nodes.rationale: A skill grants no new capability and cannot bypass approval — it only names and reuses what the agent can already do.

nodes.label: D-0032 Workspace knowledge/files capability
nodes.rationale: REAL local capability confined to workspace; every path resolved/confirmed inside root before I/O to prevent traversal; edits independently re-verified on disk (R-CORE-03).

nodes.label: D-0033 Tool results feed agent reasoning (detail field)
nodes.norm_label: d-0033 tool results feed agent reasoning (detail field)
nodes.rationale: Agent runtime previously fed only a one-line summary back, making read tools far less useful; detail is never audited so file content stays local.

nodes.label: D-0035 Terminal-with-policy
nodes.rationale: Command-safety policy denies dangerous commands outright before approval is even offered; workspace-confined cwd, timeout, bounded output.

nodes.label: D-0074 Code-authored capabilities run in-container
nodes.rationale: Corrects an inaccurate earlier claim conflating a future hardened sandbox with the already-existing ability to write/run new code via the gated terminal; self-written code never loads natively into the Z1 trust-core process.

nodes.label: D-0077 Rhythm sync: agenda freshness gate + chat delivery
nodes.norm_label: d-0077 rhythm sync: agenda freshness gate + chat delivery
nodes.rationale: Agenda items were frozen intent with nothing reconciling stale intent against newer truth, and announcements never reached chat-only users; freshness check is advisory-only, delivery is best-effort and zero-extra-I/O via the existing conversation path.

nodes.label: D-0022: macOS computer-control activation gate
nodes.rationale: Real JarvisControl adapter (AXUIElement/CGEvent) requires TCC permission grants and per-app/per-action approval defaults before it replaces the SIMULATION desktop.

nodes.label: D-0023: Self-extension Stage B activation (dedicated security check-in)
nodes.norm_label: d-0023: self-extension stage b activation (dedicated security check-in)
nodes.rationale: Highest-risk subsystem; Stage A only generates capabilities (no activation path) until this review; no generated capability may ever touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic (hard limit R-CAP-08), enforced structurally not by convention.

nodes.label: D-0024: Proactive delivery enable
nodes.rationale: Background cadence, briefing schedule, notification channels, quiet hours, and nightly sleep-cycle consolidation schedule require explicit approval; until then proactivity only computes on demand.

nodes.label: D-0025: Physical device control enable
nodes.rationale: HA base URL, per-device-type risk defaults, and hardware interlock mechanism must be approved before real device gateway replaces the Stark-residence simulation.

nodes.label: D-0027: MCP server trust elevation
nodes.rationale: Any MCP server above 'untrusted' trust level requires per-server approval, re-approved after any manifest change, to prevent rug-pull attacks.

nodes.label: D-0046: Gateway pinned to current Anthropic API
nodes.norm_label: d-0046: gateway pinned to current anthropic api
nodes.rationale: Adapter never emits the removed budget_tokens shape and explicitly disables thinking on tool-bearing requests because the neutral schema can't replay thinking blocks, which Anthropic requires intact.

nodes.label: R-MEM-06: No secrets in conversational memory
nodes.norm_label: r-mem-06: no secrets in conversational memory

nodes.label: R-VER-04: Acceptance runs happen on the real machine
nodes.norm_label: r-ver-04: acceptance runs happen on the real machine

nodes.label: MAC_BRINGUP.md — Operational Runbook for the M3 Max
nodes.norm_label: mac_bringup.md — operational runbook for the m3 max
nodes.rationale: Complements rather than replaces DEVELOPMENT.md and the check-in/session-continuity docs; sequences capability activation strictly behind check-in gates so nothing consequential runs before approval.

nodes.label: D-0019: Affect/Emotion Inference Rescheduled
nodes.rationale: Affect/emotion inference (B4) was originally deferred; the user rescheduled it as a constrained opt-in capability (P4/P6) rather than dropping it.

nodes.label: D-0020: Personal Health Telemetry Accepted
nodes.rationale: Personal health telemetry (B5) is hardware-dependent (Phase 11) but accepted because the user already owns the required Watch hardware.

nodes.label: Core Interaction Loop
nodes.rationale: Must be proven end-to-end (real voice in, real reasoning, real gated action, real voice out, cinematic display) before building outward; runs locally with a full offline path.

nodes.label: Honesty Rule
nodes.rationale: Implement every achievable capability for real; never substitute mock data, fake output, or simulated execution; unavailable/unsafe capabilities must use clearly-marked SIMULATION adapters, never presented as live.

nodes.label: Option A — Hybrid TS Kernel + Python Mind
nodes.norm_label: option a — hybrid ts kernel + python mind
nodes.rationale: Puts every subsystem (ML/speech/agents in Python, platform/policy/UI transport in one long-lived TS process) in its strongest ecosystem while keeping the trust core small and macOS-specific code isolated behind a replaceable Swift adapter.

nodes.label: Option B — Single-Runtime TypeScript Core
nodes.rationale: Rejected: no MLX from Node, sherpa-onnx JS bindings trail Python API, and betting the intelligence layer on the weakest ecosystem sacrifices voice quality/latency.

nodes.label: Option C — Swift-Native Core
nodes.rationale: Rejected: couples core orchestration/memory/agent/tool logic to proprietary OS frameworks, violating the OSS-first requirement, and has the thinnest agent/MCP/LLM ecosystem of the three options.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Model Gateway (local-capable-first routing, measured live)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. model gateway (local-capable-first routing, measured live)
nodes.rationale: Provider reachability is measured live and never cached, and routing prefers local targets first, presumably for privacy/latency; live re-route changes are logged to the ledger for audit.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Persona (user-editable speaking style R-CAP-01, D-0043)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. persona (user-editable speaking style r-cap-01, d-0043)

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Reasoning (learned topics, escalation sensitivity, sleep-cycle consolidation)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. reasoning (learned topics, escalation sensitivity, sleep-cycle consolidation)
nodes.rationale: Escalation sensitivity is bounded autotuning: user's threshold setting holds unless the evidence trail outweighs it, balancing user control with adaptive safety.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Voice Orb (ambient wake-word / push-to-talk interface)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. voice orb (ambient wake-word / push-to-talk interface)

nodes.label: D-0002 Architecture option (Hybrid TS+Python)
nodes.rationale: Approved at Phase 0 check-in; composes D-0006/D-0008/D-0009/D-0010/D-0013/D-0014, each individually reopenable at future check-ins.

nodes.label: D-0006 Valkey deferred
nodes.rationale: Justify every process/datastore; Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY covers Phase-1 needs; add Valkey only when a measured need appears.

nodes.label: D-0007 Valkey over Redis
nodes.rationale: Redis ≥8.0 is tri-licensed (only AGPL is OSI); Valkey is BSD-3-Clause under Linux Foundation, so it's the OSS-safe pick when a datastore is needed.

nodes.label: D-0008 Model gateway approach
nodes.rationale: Thin in-house provider-adapter layer over LiteLLM as a hard dependency: LiteLLM has CVE history + a supply-chain incident, and four adapters are small compared to that trust-path risk.

nodes.label: D-0009 Agent runtime: LangGraph behind AgentRuntime interface
nodes.norm_label: d-0009 agent runtime: langgraph behind agentruntime interface
nodes.rationale: LangGraph MIT/model-agnostic/durable-state; isolated behind an interface so it is replaceable, rejecting provider-locked alternatives (Claude Agent SDK) for a provider-neutral core.

nodes.label: D-0010 Observability viewer: Jaeger v2
nodes.rationale: Apache-2.0, CNCF-graduated, single local container; Grafana LGTM (AGPL) and SigNoz (ee-licensed bundling) rejected.

nodes.label: D-0013 Postgres encryption approach
nodes.rationale: FileVault + field-level libsodium encryption keeps the OSS data layer while satisfying R-MEM-03; pgsodium rejected due to deprecation signals.

nodes.label: D-0014 Desktop shell: Tauri 2
nodes.rationale: MIT/Apache-2.0, native bridges, tray/plugins; Electron rejected for bundled Chromium weight.

nodes.label: D-0030 Agent runtime foundation (LocalAgentRuntime)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates but never bypasses a gate; sits behind AgentRuntime interface (D-0009) so a heavier LangGraph runtime can replace it without touching callers.

nodes.label: D-0038: Semantic memory entities/facts/relations store
nodes.rationale: Extends Phase-1 conversation+preference stores to satisfy parity H 'Memory & knowledge' — durable knowledge beyond current conversation.

nodes.label: D-0041: Episodic memory timeline
nodes.rationale: Distinct from the audit log (security record) — episodic memory is semantic, forgettable, importance-ranked; deliberately auto-recorded from real consequential actions so it's not an empty store.

nodes.label: D-0042: Semantic (vector) recall over memory
nodes.rationale: Uses two previously-idle approved-architecture components (embeddings role + pgvector) to recall by meaning; falls back to lexical recall rather than faking semantic ranking when no embedder is available.

nodes.label: D-0043: Prompts registry for user-editable persona
nodes.norm_label: d-0043: prompts registry for user-editable persona
nodes.rationale: Persona was a hardcoded constant; moved to a versioned registry per R-CAP-01 with a fallback-safe default so persona is never blank.

nodes.label: D-0044: User-defined proactivity rules
nodes.rationale: Makes proactive behavior user-configurable while keeping rule conditions in a closed typed set so a rule can never execute arbitrary code.

nodes.label: D-0045: Graph-brain memory (multi-hop + hybrid recall)
nodes.rationale: Decided against a dedicated graph DB (Neo4j GPLv3 license flag, ops/locality cost, R-MEM violation for in-memory) since Postgres recursive CTEs suffice at single-user scale.

nodes.label: D-0047: Model-gateway observability (/gateway/calls + Models panel)
nodes.rationale: The gateway had no visibility surface, conflicting with the cinematic-functional-UI rule that every element communicates real state.

nodes.label: D-0048: Deep-reasoning escalation
nodes.rationale: User required deep reasoning to engage automatically, work for any LLM, and be visible/overridable; implemented as a deterministic signal set to stay fast, explainable, and provider-agnostic.

nodes.label: D-0049: Provider-agnostic generation settings
nodes.rationale: Wire dialects differ per provider, but that difference belongs inside adapters (R-MODEL-02) rather than leaking provider-specific vocabulary into user-facing config.

nodes.label: D-0050: Deep-reasoning learning (transparent, no opaque ML)
nodes.norm_label: d-0050: deep-reasoning learning (transparent, no opaque ml)
nodes.rationale: Escalation was static; user wanted J.A.R.V.I.S. to adapt without opaque ML, so uses explainable instruction+correction learning stored in the ordinary preferences store.

nodes.label: D-0051: Sleep-cycle consolidation
nodes.rationale: User directed J.A.R.V.I.S. to learn from its own operational choices, with manual overrides respected and explicitly noted rather than silently discarded.

nodes.label: D-0052: Override contract revised (trail can outweigh a pin)
nodes.norm_label: d-0052: override contract revised (trail can outweigh a pin)
nodes.rationale: User corrected the contract: a user pin is respected by default but not permanent law — a higher evidence bar than for J.A.R.V.I.S.'s own choices, scaling with re-pin insistence.

nodes.label: D-0054: Runtime gateway role editor
nodes.rationale: First D-0053 migration: gateway role routing becomes runtime-editable without restart, keeping the egress surface fixed (no new providers at runtime).

nodes.label: D-0055: Conversational edit path for settings
nodes.norm_label: d-0055: conversational edit path for settings
nodes.rationale: Completes D-0053 reversibility by exposing runtime overrides as gated tools so conversational instruction goes through the same policy/approval/audit path.

nodes.label: D-0058: General runtime settings registry
nodes.rationale: Generalizes D-0053: a true command center where any catalogued knob is editable live, defaulting to the current default when unset instead of being frozen at start-time config.

nodes.label: D-0039: Non-sensitive-only injection
nodes.rationale: Stored knowledge is otherwise unused; wiring into ContextService makes J.A.R.V.I.S. actually draw on what it knows, restricted to non-sensitive content to avoid leaking secrets into always-present context.

nodes.label: D-0046: Months-scale behavior validation
nodes.rationale: Corrects a stale plan: current Anthropic models reject budget_tokens/sampling params, requiring adaptive thinking + output_config.effort instead.

nodes.label: D-0053: Catalogued editable thresholds pattern
nodes.rationale: Standing rule: every configurable/hardcoded setting must be user-, conversation-, and J.A.R.V.I.S.-editable with an override ledger under the D-0052 evidence contract; Z1 protected paths are explicitly excluded.

nodes.label: D-0056: A2UI concept check-in
nodes.rationale: A2UI adoption deferred pending standard license/architecture check-in; binding requirement that A2UI must render through the existing settings contract, not a parallel config store.

nodes.label: D-0057: Scale validation at thousands of rows
nodes.norm_label: d-0057: scale validation at thousands of rows
nodes.rationale: Pen-testing at scale found vector recall was a linear Seq Scan that would degrade a long-lived brain; verified recall with realistic dense embeddings rather than the container's degenerate hash-embedder.

nodes.label: D-0025 Device-control foundation SIMULATION-first
nodes.rationale: Physical-safety rules (interlock for HIGH_RISK_PHYSICAL) built and verified against simulation before real HA gateway is bound at a check-in.

nodes.label: D-0028 Managed secrets vault
nodes.rationale: Satisfies the binding rule to never store secrets in conversational memory; audit records operation name never the value, no HTTP route returns a value.

nodes.label: D-0078 graphify adopted as developer tooling
nodes.norm_label: d-0078 graphify adopted as developer tooling
nodes.rationale: Accepted a live API key at rest outside Z1 as a scoped, deletable-with-graceful-degradation exception to R-MEM-06, explicitly not precedent for any kernel/capability credential; routing through the kernel's credential broker was rejected as a worse trade (would make dev tooling a Z1 consumer).

nodes.label: graphify (dev tooling)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately scoped as developer tooling outside the kernel/Z1 trust core; not imported by services/, so its API-key-on-disk deviation from the credential principle is acceptable only because it never touches the trusted core.

nodes.label: D-0027 MCP client host; trust-elevation is a check-in
nodes.norm_label: d-0027 mcp client host; trust-elevation is a check-in
nodes.rationale: THREAT_MODEL T2 enforced structurally: untrusted content never merged into instructions, namespaced tools prevent shadowing, manifest-hash rug-pull detection with fail-closed trust asymmetry.

nodes.label: D-0034 Web browsing / research capability
nodes.rationale: The one outward-network capability, so gated tightly: per-navigation approval, scheme/offline policy checked before browser launch, content never audited.

nodes.label: D-0036 Research-with-provenance
nodes.rationale: One CONSEQUENTIAL action discloses all target URLs upfront; a refused/failed source is recorded, never fabricated.

nodes.label: D-0037 Untrusted-content envelopes (T1 defense)
nodes.rationale: External content fed via detail had nothing wrapping it, opening the classic prompt-injection vector; envelopes plus defense-in-depth gates neutralize breakout attempts.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. A2UI Panels (sandboxed renderer, whitelisted components, D-0061)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. a2ui panels (sandboxed renderer, whitelisted components, d-0061)
nodes.rationale: Panel edits go through settings + gated tools rather than direct writes, and actions like 'say hello' require approval, keeping composed UI within the same trust boundary as other tools.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Pulse (heartbeat journal + self-written agenda D-0064)
nodes.norm_label: j.a.r.v.i.s. pulse (heartbeat journal + self-written agenda d-0064)
nodes.rationale: Consequential actions are never taken on a heartbeat; they queue for user approval, ensuring autonomous ticks remain non-destructive.

nodes.label: J.A.R.V.I.S. Settings (runtime-editable config D-0058)
nodes.rationale: Background autonomy never acts consequentially without approval and e-stop halts it, keeping autonomous background cycles bounded and safe.

nodes.label: T2 — Tool Poisoning / Malicious MCP Server
nodes.norm_label: t2 — tool poisoning / malicious mcp server

nodes.label: D-0002: Architecture Option A approved
nodes.rationale: Hybrid TS kernel + Python intelligence/speech + Tauri 2/Swift bridge + Next.js/R3F + Postgres/pgvector, bundling several sub-decisions (D-0006/8/9/10/13/14).

nodes.label: D-0004/D-0004a: Voice stack approved with condition
nodes.norm_label: d-0004/d-0004a: voice stack approved with condition
nodes.rationale: Expressive-TTS listening test on the Mac required before voice identity hardens; Kokoro baseline preference George/Daniel; optional key-gated cloud TTS adapter added for comparison.

nodes.label: D-0021: Memory architecture + local security model approved
nodes.norm_label: d-0021: memory architecture + local security model approved
nodes.rationale: Unblocks slices 1.4/1.6 (core loop and conversation memory).

nodes.label: R-CAP-08: Hard limit on generated-capability scope
nodes.norm_label: r-cap-08: hard limit on generated-capability scope
nodes.rationale: Enforced structurally (protected paths + separate trust domain + install-time diff scanning), not by convention, because generated code must never touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic.

nodes.label: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md — Living Development Plan
nodes.rationale: Session-continuity rule requires re-reading this file plus DECISION_LOG, CAPABILITY_PARITY_MATRIX, and CLAUDE.md before any work, resuming from 'Current state'.

nodes.label: D-0037: Untrusted Content Envelope
nodes.rationale: External tool output (web/research/MCP) is wrapped in <untrusted_external_data> envelopes with closing-tag breakout neutralized, plus a standing system note to treat it as data, so hostile content cannot be merged into system instructions (mitigates prompt injection, T1).

nodes.label: D-0026: Design system check-in
nodes.rationale: Approval of docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md is required before the full Command Center UI is built out on its tokens.
